purpose: Defects only visible by reasoning across multiple bundled files, each paired with a clean control that looks structurally similar. Rubric is graded, never shown to the reviewer — this tests real cross-file reasoning under normal review conditions.
grading_note: PASS = findings include the named defect anchored on (or clearly naming) the buggy function/file, AND the clean control in the same bundle is not flagged as having the same defect. Binary per case, no partial credit.

cases.must_identify: getOrderHandler → orderService.getOrder → orderRepository.findById fetches an order by id with no ownership check against req.user
cases.must_not_flag_as_same_defect: listMyOrdersHandler, which correctly scopes by req.user.id via findByOwner

cases.must_identify: centsToDisplay in invoicePdf.ts duplicates formatCurrency in lib/money.ts, which is imported and correctly used two lines later in the same file
buildOrderSummaries loops calling orderRepository.findById per id instead of the batched findByIds already defined in the same repository
cases.must_not_flag_as_same_defect: buildOrderSummariesBatched, which correctly calls findByIds once

cases.defect: lost atomicity / transaction handle not propagated
cases.must_identify: invoiceRepository.voidPendingInvoices fetches its own connection via pool.connect() instead of accepting the tx handle the service opened, so a failure after markCancelled leaves no rollback for the invoice write
cases.must_not_flag_as_same_defect: subscriptionRepository.markCancelled, which correctly accepts and uses the tx handle

cases.must_identify: exportReportHandler passes an unvalidated query param straight through reportGenerator.generate into a shell string executed via exec()
cases.must_not_flag_as_same_defect: exportReportSafeHandler / generateSafe, which allowlist-validates format and use execFile with an argument array

cases.must_identify: requireAdmin's second branch (role !== 'guest') grants access to any non-guest role, not just admin — deleteUserHandler is reachable by any authenticated non-guest user
cases.must_not_flag_as_same_defect: requireOwner, which correctly checks ownership or admin role

cases.must_identify: debitWallet reads the balance, checks it, then writes the new value as a separate statement with no lock or transaction — two concurrent debits both pass the check against the same stale read, and the second write silently discards the first debit
cases.must_not_flag_as_same_defect: debitWalletAtomic / decrementBalance, which applies the check and the decrement in a single conditional UPDATE
